Glameow

Normal

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Glameow is a Normal-type Catty Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 3.9 kg. It evolves into Purugly. Its highest base stat is Speed (85), with a base stat total of 310.
